publicCopy.titleZh: TrendForce：五大企业级 SSD 品牌 2026 Q2 收入近 $37.59 billion
publicCopy.titleEn: TrendForce: Top five enterprise-SSD brands neared $37.59 billion in 2026 Q2 revenue
publicCopy.summaryZh: TrendForce 表示，五大企业级 SSD 品牌在 2026 Q2 的合计收入约为 $37.59 billion，环比增长 103.6%；报告将增长归因于出货量增加和合约价格上涨，并预计生成式 AI agent 服务、云厂商数据中心部署和 NVIDIA GB 系列机架出货将支撑 2026 Q3 需求。这里的收入数据与需求判断来自 TrendForce 研究，不代表厂商逐项披露，也不等于数据中心资本开支或服务器出货已被逐一确认。
publicCopy.summaryEn: TrendForce says the top five enterprise-SSD brands generated nearly $37.59 billion in combined 2026 Q2 revenue, up 103.6% quarter over quarter, citing higher shipments and contract prices. It expects generative-AI agent adoption, CSP data-center deployments and NVIDIA GB-series rack shipments to support 2026 Q3 demand. The figures and outlook are TrendForce research, not itemized vendor disclosures or proof of data-center capex or server shipments.

publicClaims.claim: TrendForce reports combined 2Q26 enterprise-SSD revenue of nearly $37.59 billion for the top five brands, up 103.6% quarter over quarter, and expects AI-agent adoption and data-center deployments to support 3Q26 demand.
